````````````text
"""Audit every completed response without qualifying a stopped cohort."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections
import importlib.util
import json

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = Path('/tmp/slotstream-optimization-execution')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('v544_stopped',BASE/'public-planner-qualified-fixture-cohort-v537/run.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
m.load()
raw = m.OUT/'planner-512'; execution=m.HERE/'planner-512/execution'
q=m.c.read(execution/'qualification.json'); p=m.c.read(m.HERE/'planner-512/protocol.json')
assert not q['qualified'] and not q['completed'] and q['cleanup_complete'] and q['proofs_unchanged']
assert q['within_reservation'] and q['remaining_jobs']==[]
assert q['execution_receipt_sha256']==m.digest(execution/'receipt.json')
rows=list(map(json.loads,(raw/'results.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()))
assert len(rows)==16 and sum('metrics' in r for r in rows)==15
expected=m.fixtures(512); observed=[]; groups=collections.defaultdict(dict); peaks=[]
for row in rows:
    number,arm=row['round'],row['arm']; cell=raw/f'{number}-{arm}'
    first=m.c.read(cell/'warmup.json')
    phases=[('first',first)]+([('measured',row)] if 'metrics' in row else [])
    for phase,response in phases:
        metrics=response['metrics'];stats=metrics['stats']
        assert metrics['prompt_ids']==expected[phase]['prompt_ids']
        m.bench.validate_work_observation(p['work_constraints'],arm,stats)
        assert len(metrics['output_ids'])==stats['decodeTokens']==16
        assert stats['prefillComputePasses']==[512,512,512,512,3]
        peak=stats['sampledFootprint']['peakBytes'];peaks.append(peak)
        assert 0<peak<=p['maximum_sampled_footprint_bytes']
        observed.append({'round':number,'arm':arm,'phase':phase,'output_tokens':16,'sampled_peak_bytes':peak})
        groups[number,phase][arm]=response
    m.helper.validate_observation(p,arm,row,first['metrics'],row.get('metrics'))
    wire=cell/'public-plan-response.json'
    assert m.helper.parse_public_plan(wire.read_bytes())==row['public_plan']
    assert m.digest(wire)==row['public_plan_response_sha256']
exact=[]
for identity,arms in groups.items():
    if set(arms)!={'reference','automatic'}:continue
    a,b=arms['reference'],arms['automatic']
    assert a['text']==b['text']
    assert all(a['metrics'][k]==b['metrics'][k] for k in ['prompt_ids','output_ids'])
    assert all(a['metrics']['stats'][k]==b['metrics']['stats'][k] for k in p['required_equal_work']+['prefillComputePasses'])
    exact.append(list(identity))
assert len(exact)==15
last=rows[-1]
assert last['round']==8 and last['arm']=='reference' and 'metrics' not in last
assert last['exclusion']=='warmup resource gate: swap activity during large-pool startup/warmup'
assert last['after_warmup_vm']['swapins']-last['before_startup']['swapins']==28
assert last['after_warmup_vm']['swapouts']==last['before_startup']['swapouts']
assert not (raw/'8-reference/response.ndjson').exists()
memory=m.c.read(execution/'memory.json')
assert memory['before']['swapouts']==memory['after']['swapouts']
assert memory['remaining_owned_members_after_cleanup']==[]
last_stats=m.c.read(raw/'8-reference/warmup.json')['metrics']['stats']
assert m.bench.resource_exclusions(last_stats,p)==[]
try:
    m.assess('planner-512')
    raise AssertionError('incomplete cohort accepted')
except ValueError as exc:
    assert str(exc)=='full fixed cohort incomplete'
result={'classification':'Observed-only stopped cohort audit; no qualification or timing claim.',
        'completed':False,'qualified':False,'recorded_cells':16,'completed_measured_responses':15,
        'completed_first_responses':16,'all31_original16_output_work_and_sampled_caps_pass':True,
        'maximum_sampled_peak_bytes':max(peaks),'exact_complete_pairs_by_phase':exact,
        'stop_round':8,'stop_arm':'reference','startup_swapins_at_stop':28,'new_swapouts':0,
        'stop_first_response_other_resource_exclusions':[],
        'minimum_outer_sampled_reclaimable_bytes':min(r['reclaimable_bytes'] for r in memory['samples']),
        'maximum_outer_owned_rss_bytes':max(r['owned_rss_bytes'] for r in memory['samples']),
        'original_startup_swapin_abort_retained':True,
        'source_build_native_proofs_unchanged':True,'cleanup_complete':True,'remaining_jobs':[],
        'within_reservation':True,'elapsed_seconds':q['elapsed_seconds'],'observations':observed,
        'ineligible_rows':[{k:r.get(k) for k in ['round','arm','valid','startup_and_warmup_valid','error','exclusion']}
                           for r in rows if not r.get('valid')],
        'evidence':{str(f):m.digest(f) for f in [execution/'qualification.json',execution/'receipt.json',
            execution/'memory.json',raw/'results.jsonl',raw/'completion.json',m.HERE/'planner-512/protocol.json']}}
m.c.write_new(HERE/'audit.json',result)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['observations','evidence','exact_complete_pairs_by_phase']},indent=2))
````````````
